name: Antoine Dubois
bio:
Antoine's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued a degree in Human Resources, always with the goal of combining his professional skills with his love for racing. After graduating, he started at a local logistics company, quickly rising through the ranks before making the jump to Junior Kart Team.

At Junior Kart Team, Antoine focuses on creating a supportive and challenging environment for all staff. He believes in fostering talent from within and is always looking for ways to improve team morale and efficiency. His methodical approach and strong interpersonal skills make him a valuable asset to the organization, ensuring the team attracts and retains top talent.

Antoine is an innovator always looking for new ways to improve team dynamics and performance, he is working on new strategies to enhance communication and create opportunities for professional development, setting him apart in the competitive world of motorsport HR.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Antoine is of average height with a slender build and a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always has a motivational quote of the day on his desk.
Organizes his desk supplies with extreme precision.
Drinks Earl Grey tea every afternoon at 3 PM sharp.
